features.name: Leaf veins
features.blurb: Veins carry water in and sugar out of the leaf. Fine veins branch until no cell is far from one.

features.name: Leaf cells
features.blurb: Each green box is a living cell packed with chloroplasts. Cell walls give the leaf its tiled look.

features.name: Grain facets
features.blurb: Each grain is a tiny rock with its own shape. Clear grains are mostly quartz, the stuff of good glass.
